blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — South Cotabato expects P1 billion in locally-sourced income in 2026 after collecting P992.32 million last year, the highest among the four provinces in Soccsksargen (Region 12). Gov. Reynaldo Tamayo Jr. said the province needs only about P8 million more to breach the P1-billion mark, a target he is optimistic South Cotabato can hit this year. Data from the Bureau of Local Government Finance’s (BLGF) 2025 Statement of Receipts and Expenditures showed South Cotabato posting P992,321,766.73 in locally sourced income.
